sources.source_mutability_note: The first and final audit observed differing raw SHA for one same official PNG URL; current run double fetch matches exactly. Preserve observed SHA, avoid treating URL alone as immutable identity.

insight.causal_model: Author intent/use → candidate expressive full-form writing language → local optical corrections based on glyph structure → test multi-glyph consistency and reading suitability → reversibly retract design decisions.

cards.creator: 甘薇云（左體 Left Font）
cards.trigger: Brief actually calls for provocative/assertive display lettering, not neutral body text
cards.rollback: Shape reads mechanically distorted or another glyph's open counter collapses; revise local gesture or abandon effect, not global blind scaling.

cards.creator: justfont／金萱
cards.trigger: Lettering is meant for dense repeated reading or small-size clarity rather than expressive one-off display
cards.rollback: Readability or coherent reading texture decreases, even if the single stroke was aesthetically dramatic.

cards.creator: justfont／金萱
cards.trigger: Complex or heavy glyph appears black/dense at actual intended display size
cards.rollback: A simplification changes literal Hanzi identity, distorts semantic components or looks worse in the combined title.

cards.creator: Typotheque／郑楚阳
cards.trigger: A proposed characteristic stroke/radical transformation has been applied to multiple new characters
cards.rollback: The family-wide visual rhythm or legibility degrades under changed target codepoints.

audit_fix.affected: transparent PNG color analysis; first pass converted to RGB without compositing, false dark ink coverage

hard_stop: Do not re-run geometry R1–R9, do not attribute static image to historical pressure/steps, do not train/reprint protected source images without permission, do not claim artistry from provenance, algorithms or tests alone.
next_real_goal: Causally test ONE precise designer change with scope/use and rollback conditions on distinct previously unseen glyph structures, and use actual independent aesthetic review before promotion.
